shardId.description: The shard ID for an individual record result.

sequenceNumber.description: The sequence number for an individual record result.

encryptionType.description: Type of encryption applied to the data

errorCode.description:
An unsuccessfully-processed record includes ErrorCode and ErrorMessage values. ErrorCode reflects the type of error
and can be one of the following values: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException or InternalFailure.
Note: Only valid for {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecords}. {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecord} throws the exception directly

errorMessage.description:
An unsuccessfully-processed record includes ErrorCode and ErrorMessage values. ErrorMessage provides more detailed information about
the ProvisionedThroughputExceededException exception including the account ID, stream name, and shard ID of the record that was throttled.
Note: Only valid for {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecords}. {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecord} throws the exception directly
